purpose: Define how a generic Emberwright workflow could recreate the HavenwildProjectProfile instead of requiring permanent Havenwild-specific editor code.

project_identity.projectType: 2D top-down open-world life-sim sandbox with optional adventure

migrationNotes: Names like Alderreach, Havenwild-specific zones, gameplay families, and world settings should become profile data.
The editor shell should ask ProjectProfile for display labels, default workspaces, panel availability, runtime launch commands, and project vocabulary.
The same wizard can later create non-Havenwild projects using different templates and vocabularies.
acceptance: A generic workflow can produce an equivalent profile seed from structured selections.
Havenwild continues to load exactly as before during migration.
Hardcoded Havenwild values are inventoried before being moved behind profile lookups.
